prerequisites: Having completed the course "Business Administration and Industrial Organization" from the first year of the Degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Help in decision-making during the process of creating a company, fostering creativity among students so that they adopt an active attitude, assuming the challenge of creating their own company.
Know and understand the implications and requirements of creating a company.
Identify the qualities and knowledge that an entrepreneur starting a business must possess.
Master tools and methodologies that stimulate business idea generation processes.
Adequately know and understand business opportunity analysis and evaluation techniques.
Apply knowledge of general and specific environmental analysis.
Know the formal requirements for establishing a company.

Students must have the ability to gather and interpret relevant data (usually within their field of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific, or ethical issues.
Develop leadership and teamwork skills in both national and international contexts, with the necessary flexibility to adapt to new situations in the field of agri-food engineering.
Acquire basic knowledge about the use and programming of computers, operating systems, databases, and computer programs with application in engineering.
Adequately know the concept of a company, its institutional and legal framework, and its organization and management.

Understand, know, and use the principles of Rural Engineering. Knowledge and ability to perform structural calculations and construction in their field of action. Know the principles of electrotechnics and rural electrification. Know and be able to select motors and machinery and adapt their agricultural and/or agro-industrial use. Know the principles of agricultural hydraulics and irrigation systems. Knowledge of project organization and management in the fields of agriculture, green spaces and landscape ornamentation, construction of agro-industrial industries and their facilities. Knowledge of the functions and responsibilities of agents involved in building and their professional or business organization and administrative, management and processing procedures. Ability to draft studies, basic studies, and occupational health and safety plans, and coordinate safety during the project or execution phase. Ability to draft documents that are part of multidisciplinary execution projects.

Knowledge of the principles of agricultural business valuation and commercialization. Aptitude for analyzing and making decisions related to the economic-financial situation of the company. Ability to handle marketing tools and prepare agricultural valuation reports.

syllabus_topics: Part 3: Generation of business models using "Business Model Canvas".
Part 5: Legal aspects of the creation of commercial companies.
assessment_rules: The final grade is obtained by considering various activities: active classroom and tutorial participation, individual and group practical assignments submitted and presented throughout the course, and the final project. Active classroom participation (asking questions, answering queries, participating in discussions and debates, etc.) counts for 20%. Practical assignments (solving exercises and problems, analysis and/or presentation and defense of individual/team work, cases, etc.) counts for 80%. In case of not passing the ordinary evaluation, a second call (resit) will be offered, with generally identical conditions regarding format, content, and evaluation criteria. For the resit, students are recommended to review errors, consult with faculty, and create a personalized study plan.
